prompts.title: Technology And Learning
prompts.prompt:
Some people think that technology has made learning easier and more effective, while others believe it has created more distractions.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

prompts.title: Public Transport
prompts.prompt:
Many large cities suffer from traffic congestion and air pollution.

What are the main causes of these problems, and what measures could be taken to solve them?

prompts.title: Work-Life Balance
prompts.prompt:
In many countries, more people are working from home instead of travelling to an office every day.

Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?

prompts.title: Practical Skills In Education
prompts.prompt:
Schools should spend more time teaching practical skills, such as financial management and communication, and less time teaching traditional academic subjects.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

prompts.title: Environmental Responsibility
prompts.prompt:
Some people believe that individuals should take responsibility for protecting the environment, while others think governments and large companies should be mainly responsible.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

prompts.title: International Travel
prompts.prompt:
International travel is becoming cheaper and more common.

Why is this happening, and do you think it is a positive or negative development?

prompts.title: Online Education
prompts.prompt:
More universities are offering courses online instead of teaching students mainly on campus.

Do the advantages of this development outweigh the disadvantages?

prompts.title: Public Health
prompts.prompt:
Many people do not get enough physical exercise in their daily lives.

What are the reasons for this, and how can this problem be solved?

prompts.title: Children And Screens
prompts.prompt:
Some people think children should not be allowed to use smartphones at school.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

prompts.title: Working Hours
prompts.prompt:
Some people believe employees should work fewer hours each week, while others think long working hours are necessary for economic success.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

prompts.title: City Life
prompts.prompt:
More people are moving from small towns to big cities.

Why is this happening, and what problems can it cause?

prompts.title: Public Money
prompts.prompt:
Governments should spend more money on public services than on arts and cultural events.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

prompts.title: Ageing Population
prompts.prompt:
In many countries, the proportion of older people is increasing.

Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?

prompts.title: Plastic Waste
prompts.prompt:
Plastic waste is causing serious environmental problems in many parts of the world.

What are the causes of this problem, and what solutions can you suggest?

prompts.title: Family Meals
prompts.prompt:
Some people think families should eat meals together every day, while others believe this is no longer realistic.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

prompts.title: Exam Pressure
prompts.prompt:
Students today face too much pressure from examinations.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

prompts.title: Tourism And Local Culture
prompts.prompt:
Tourism brings money to local communities but can also damage local culture and the environment.

Do the advantages of tourism outweigh the disadvantages?

prompts.title: Changing Jobs
prompts.prompt:
Many people change jobs several times during their working lives.

Why does this happen, and do you think it is a positive or negative development?

prompts.title: Food Imports
prompts.prompt:
Some people believe countries should produce all the food they need locally, while others think importing food is beneficial.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

prompts.title: Museums
prompts.prompt:
Museums should be free for everyone to visit.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

prompts.title: Parenting Classes
prompts.prompt:
All parents should be required to attend parenting classes before having a child.

To what extent do you agree or disagree?

prompts.title: Noise Pollution
prompts.prompt:
Noise pollution is becoming a serious problem in many cities.

What are the causes, and what can be done to reduce it?

prompts.title: Sports In Society
prompts.prompt:
Some people think professional athletes are good role models, while others disagree.

Discuss both views and give your own opinion.

prompts.title: Remote Work
prompts.prompt:
Working from home has become common in many industries.

Why has this happened, and how might it affect workers and employers?
